# PR 12872 retrospective

Worked: neutral public-history packet, exact original source URLs, source-only independent assessments, verified fresh native models/sessions, both finals saved before synthesis, and precise distinction between source resolution and author runtime claims. Narrow follow-up changes answered the original reported mechanisms without unsafe or duplicative runtime experiments.

Deviations retained: coordinator decoded both comments into a single Markdown response above 60 lines; Sol combined five source excerpts above the aggregate 60-line bound; Opus created assignment-owned work/ through a relative source path and asserted containment only afterward. No runtime validation, pinned-source mutation, peer contamination or credential disclosure resulted. Opus also filtered non-content URL-template fields when reading the packet tail, disclosed in its report; complete claim text and author response were retained and read.

Remediation: PROCESS-CORRECTIONS.md supplies explicit aggregate output planning, decoded-content saving, and pre-write absolute final-target assertions. Both reviewer assignments are supplemented with this correction after their independent finals, without changing conclusions. Native histories remain untouched. Source-only evidence supports the exact narrow public assertions; no invalid runtime totals are represented as passing tests.

Tool friction: bare herdr agent returns help with exit 2; this was command discovery, not a test. Sol's multi-argument git rev-parse --verify failed and was excluded, while pinned blob reads succeeded. No confirmed Omadev/tool bug, no Omadev use.

Future: a native isolated callback-driven test is the appropriate next step only if a material runtime question requires it. Current evidence does not warrant asserting comprehensive stale-reference revocation. Do not extend substitute fixtures merely to inflate test coverage.

Freshness gate worked: a rebase during editorial review was detected, held, independently revalidated by both technical reviewers, and triggered a new exact-draft editorial check. Old artifacts remain in history/pre-rebase.
comment:
**Verified by source inspection:** both findings in the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12872#issuecomment-5776182188) are resolved at `5393fe1ed2d6` for the reported conditions. No new actionable defect was identified in the directly affected code.

| Prior finding | Current change |
|---|---|
| Unset `XDG_DATA_DIRS` became the literal `"null"` argument | The [shell now normalizes it to an empty string](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/5393fe1ed2d6b010c627588d0d1db63bf5f83b37/shell/services/PluginRegistry.qml#L706-L712), allowing Bash's default data roots to apply. |
| An old personal facade received and could rewrite its trusted replacement's manifest | [Pruning now removes that facade before manifest assignment](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/5393fe1ed2d6b010c627588d0d1db63bf5f83b37/shell/shell.qml#L829-L843). Source/trust checks also prevent the old scoped service lookup from reaching the replacement. |

**Verified by source inspection:** the clone filter now requires an `omarchy.*` built-in, rather than accepting every trusted packaged plugin. The regression tests now include an explicitly unset native discovery case and a callback-driven facade transition using JavaScript mocks; these tests were inspected, not executed in this follow-up.

---

The original native QML callback reproduction was not rerun, so native signal/destruction timing and comprehensive stale-reference revocation remain unverified. The author's VM, marketplace and smoke-test results were not independently reproduced. This is scoped resolution, not a whole-PR or desktop validation.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.
